mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 13 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 15, low 11.

The United States carried out air strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island after naval mines hit five ships in the Strait of Hormuz earlier this week.

Kosovo's national football team was beaten 3-0 by the Republic of Ireland, with a red card shown to Kreshnik Hajriz in the 26th minute; coach Franco Foda said the squad has high individual quality but must improve its collective play.

The Euro 2028 qualifying draw placed Kosovo and Albania in the same group, with the competition set to begin on 6 December; the two teams will not meet each other in this cycle.

U.S. Ambassador to Albania Eric Wendt introduced the "Payday Activities" program, a tradition rooted in the U.S. military, at the American embassy in Tirana.

A South Korean woman went viral after hosting an extravagant party to celebrate her divorce, inviting family and close friends to mark the occasion.
